ingredients: 4 ripe tomatoes;2 balls of mozzarella (250 g);1 bunch fresh basil;4 tbsp olive oil;2 tbsp balsamic vinegar;salt and pepper
recipe: Take the tomatoes and the mozzarella out of the fridge 30 minutes before, so they taste of something.;Cut the tomatoes into 1 cm slices. Drain the mozzarella and pat it dry with kitchen paper, then cut it into 1 cm slices as well.;Lay the slices on a large plate, alternating tomato, mozzarella and a basil leaf, slightly overlapping.;Season the tomatoes with salt and freshly ground pepper.;Just before serving, drizzle with the olive oil and a few drops of balsamic vinegar. Serve with bread for the juices.

ingredients: 16 fresh oysters;100 g spinach;2 shallots;60 g butter;40 g breadcrumbs;1 bunch parsley;1 lemon
recipe: Heat the oven to 230 °C (grill function if you have it). Scrub the oysters under cold water.;Open the oysters with an oyster knife: hold them with a towel, push the knife into the hinge and twist. Cut the muscle and keep each oyster in the deep half of the shell with its juice.;Chop the shallots, the spinach and the parsley very finely.;Melt the butter in a pan and cook the shallots for 2 minutes until soft. Add spinach and parsley and cook for 2 more minutes until wilted. Season with pepper and a squeeze of lemon.;Take the pan off the heat and mix in the breadcrumbs.;Put the oysters on a baking tray on a layer of coarse salt (or crumpled foil) so they stand straight. Top each one with a spoonful of the spinach mixture.;Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the topping is golden and the edges of the oysters curl. Serve at once with lemon wedges.

ingredients: 1 baguette;4 ripe tomatoes;2 garlic cloves;1 bunch fresh basil;4 tbsp olive oil;salt
recipe: Dice the tomatoes (remove the watery seeds), put them in a sieve with a pinch of salt and let them drain for 10 minutes.;Cut the baguette diagonally into 1.5 cm slices. Brush them lightly with olive oil.;Toast the slices in a grill pan or under the oven grill for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden and crisp.;Rub each warm slice with a halved garlic clove - the crispy bread grates the garlic like a rasp.;Mix the tomatoes with torn basil, the rest of the olive oil and a pinch of salt.;Spoon the tomatoes on the bread only just before serving, so the bread stays crunchy.

ingredients: 4 slices of goat cheese log;4 slices of baguette;150 g mixed salad leaves;50 g walnuts;2 tbsp honey;3 tbsp olive oil;1 tbsp vinegar
recipe: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Line a baking tray with baking paper.;Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes until fragrant and chop them roughly.;Put the baguette slices on the tray and a slice of goat cheese on each one. Drizzle with a little olive oil.;Bake for 5 to 6 minutes until the cheese is soft and slightly golden at the edges.;Meanwhile whisk 3 tbsp olive oil, the vinegar, 1 tsp honey, salt and pepper into a dressing and toss the salad leaves with it.;Divide the salad onto 4 plates, add the walnuts and place a warm toast on top.;Drizzle the rest of the honey over the hot cheese and serve immediately.

ingredients: 300 g cooked prawns;1 small lettuce;4 tbsp mayonnaise;2 tbsp ketchup;1 lemon;1 pinch paprika
recipe: If the prawns are frozen, thaw them in the fridge and dry them well with kitchen paper.;Mix the mayonnaise with the ketchup, 1 to 2 tsp lemon juice, a pinch of salt and pepper into a pink sauce. Taste and add more lemon if needed.;Wash the lettuce, dry it well and cut it into thin strips.;Put the lettuce into 4 glasses or small bowls.;Mix three quarters of the prawns with half of the sauce and spoon them onto the lettuce.;Top with the rest of the sauce and the remaining prawns.;Finish with a pinch of paprika and a lemon wedge on the rim. Serve cold.

ingredients: 1 kg ripe tomatoes;1 cucumber;1 red pepper;1 garlic clove;5 tbsp olive oil;2 tbsp sherry vinegar;salt
recipe: Cut a small cross into the tomatoes, pour boiling water over them for 30 seconds, then peel them and cut them into quarters.;Peel the cucumber, remove the seeds of the pepper and chop both roughly. Peel the garlic.;Put a few small cubes of cucumber and pepper aside for the garnish.;Blend the vegetables with the olive oil, the sherry vinegar and 1 tsp salt for 2 minutes until very smooth.;Push the soup through a sieve if you like it extra fine. Taste and add salt or vinegar.;Chill for at least 1 hour (the soup must be really cold).;Serve in bowls or glasses with the vegetable cubes and a drizzle of olive oil.

ingredients: 150 g cured ham;150 g salami;200 g hard cheese;100 g olives;1 baguette;1 jar of cornichons
recipe: Take the meat and the cheese out of the fridge 30 minutes before serving, so they are full of flavour.;Cut the cheese into sticks or triangles and the salami into thin slices.;Fold the ham slices loosely into waves or rolls.;Put small bowls with olives and cornichons on a large wooden board.;Arrange the meat and the cheese around the bowls in small groups, filling the gaps.;Slice the baguette and serve it next to the board.

ingredients: 500 g mushrooms;1 onion;30 g butter;800 ml vegetable stock;150 ml cream;salt and pepper
recipe: Clean the mushrooms with a brush or kitchen paper (do not wash them) and slice them. Chop the onion.;Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 3 minutes until soft.;Add the mushrooms, turn up the heat and fry for 8 minutes until they lose their water and turn golden. Keep a few slices aside for the garnish.;Pour in the hot stock, bring to the boil and simmer for 15 minutes.;Add the cream and blend the soup until smooth.;Season with salt and pepper and heat it again without boiling.;Serve with the fried mushroom slices on top.

ingredients: 300 g very fresh beef fillet;50 g rocket;40 g parmesan;1 lemon;4 tbsp olive oil;salt and pepper
recipe: Wrap the beef fillet tightly in cling film and put it in the freezer for 30 to 40 minutes, until it is firm but not frozen.;Cut it with a very sharp knife into slices as thin as possible.;Put each slice between two sheets of baking paper and flatten it gently with the bottom of a pan.;Lay the slices on cold plates so they cover the plate.;Season with salt, pepper and a little lemon juice.;Top with rocket and shave the parmesan over it with a peeler.;Drizzle with olive oil and serve immediately.

ingredients: 400 g very fresh white fish;5 limes;1 red onion;1 chili;1 bunch coriander;salt
recipe: Remove any skin and bones from the fish and cut it into 1.5 cm cubes. Keep it in the fridge.;Cut the red onion into very thin half rings, rinse them in cold water and drain them (this makes them milder).;Squeeze the limes. Remove the seeds of the chili and chop it finely.;Put the fish in a glass bowl, season with salt and pour the lime juice over it, so that it is fully covered.;Leave it in the fridge for 10 to 15 minutes, until the outside is white and the inside is still slightly translucent.;Mix in the onion, the chili and the chopped coriander.;Taste, add salt and serve in cold bowls.

ingredients: 12 spring roll wrappers;2 carrots;1/4 white cabbage;100 g bean sprouts;2 tbsp soy sauce;oil for frying;sweet chili sauce
recipe: Cut the carrots and the cabbage into very thin strips.;Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok and stir-fry the vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the bean sprouts and the soy sauce and stir-fry for 1 more minute.;Put the vegetables into a sieve and let them cool completely (a wet filling makes the rolls burst).;Lay a wrapper like a diamond, put 2 tbsp filling near the bottom corner, fold the bottom up, fold in the sides and roll it up tightly. Seal the tip with a little water.;Heat the oil to 175 °C (a cube of bread turns golden in 30 seconds).;Fry the rolls in batches for 3 to 4 minutes until golden and crispy. Drain them on kitchen paper.;Serve hot with sweet chili sauce.

ingredients: 1 can chickpeas (400 g);3 tbsp tahini;1 lemon;1 garlic clove;4 tbsp olive oil;1 pinch paprika;4 flatbreads
recipe: Drain the chickpeas and keep the liquid. For an extra smooth hummus, rub off the skins.;Put the chickpeas, the tahini, the juice of the lemon, the garlic, 2 tbsp olive oil and 1/2 tsp salt into a blender.;Blend for 3 to 4 minutes. Add the chickpea liquid spoon by spoon until the hummus is creamy and light.;Taste and add salt or lemon.;Warm the flatbreads in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.;Spread the hummus on a plate with a spoon, making a hollow. Fill it with olive oil and sprinkle with paprika.;Serve with the warm flatbread.

ingredients: 500 g very fresh salmon fillet;3 tbsp salt;3 tbsp sugar;1 bunch dill;2 tbsp mustard;1 tbsp honey;8 slices of rye bread
recipe: Start 2 days before. Remove the bones of the salmon with tweezers and pat it dry.;Mix the salt, the sugar, freshly ground pepper and half of the chopped dill.;Put the salmon skin side down on cling film and cover the flesh with the mixture.;Wrap it tightly, put it in a dish with a weight on top and leave it in the fridge for 48 hours. Turn it every 12 hours.;Scrape off the cure, rinse the salmon briefly and pat it dry. Press the rest of the dill onto the flesh.;Mix the mustard, the honey, a little chopped dill and 1 tbsp oil into a sauce.;Cut the salmon diagonally into very thin slices and serve on rye bread with the sauce.

ingredients: 1 kg onions;40 g butter;1 litre vegetable stock;100 ml dry white wine;4 slices of baguette;120 g gruyère cheese
recipe: Cut the onions in half and then into thin slices.;Melt the butter in a large heavy pot. Add the onions and a pinch of salt.;Cook them over medium to low heat for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until they are soft and deep golden brown. If they stick, add a splash of water.;Pour in the wine and scrape the bottom of the pot. Let it boil for 1 minute.;Add the stock and simmer for 15 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.;Toast the baguette slices. Heat the oven grill.;Pour the soup into oven-proof bowls, put a toast on each and cover with the grated gruyère.;Grill for 3 to 5 minutes until the cheese bubbles and turns brown. Careful, the bowls are very hot.

ingredients: 2 burrata (250 g);400 g cherry tomatoes;1 bunch fresh basil;4 tbsp olive oil;flaky salt and pepper
recipe: Take the burrata out of the fridge 30 minutes before serving.;Halve the cherry tomatoes, mix them with 2 tbsp olive oil and a pinch of flaky salt and leave them for 10 minutes.;Put the burrata in the middle of a plate.;Arrange the tomatoes and their juice around it and add the basil leaves.;At the table, cut the burrata open so the creamy inside runs out.;Finish with the rest of the olive oil, flaky salt and pepper. Serve with bread.

ingredients: 1 kg pumpkin;1 onion;1 piece of ginger;800 ml vegetable stock;200 ml coconut milk;2 tbsp pumpkin seed oil
recipe: Peel the pumpkin, remove the seeds and cut it into 3 cm cubes (with a Hokkaido pumpkin you can keep the skin).;Chop the onion. Peel the ginger and grate about 2 cm of it.;Fry the onion and the ginger in a little oil for 3 minutes until soft.;Add the pumpkin and the stock, bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes until the pumpkin is very soft.;Add the coconut milk (keep 2 tbsp for the garnish) and blend until smooth.;Season with salt and pepper and add more stock if it is too thick.;Serve with a swirl of coconut milk and a few drops of pumpkin seed oil.

ingredients: 400 g raw prawns;6 garlic cloves;1 dried chili;100 ml olive oil;1 bunch parsley;bread to serve
recipe: Peel the prawns, remove the dark vein along the back and pat them very dry. Season with salt.;Slice the garlic thinly and crumble the chili.;Warm the olive oil with the garlic and the chili in a small pan (ideally clay) over medium heat.;When the garlic starts to sizzle and turns light golden (after about 2 minutes), add the prawns.;Cook them for 1 minute, turn them and cook for 1 to 2 more minutes until just pink and curled.;Take the pan off the heat and stir in the chopped parsley.;Serve sizzling in the pan with bread to dip into the garlic oil.

ingredients: 600 g veal roast;1 can tuna (160 g);4 anchovy fillets;150 g mayonnaise;2 tbsp capers;1 lemon
recipe: Take the veal out of the fridge 30 minutes before. Heat the oven to 160 °C.;Season the veal with salt and pepper and brown it in a little oil in a hot pan on all sides for 5 minutes.;Roast it in the oven for about 30 to 40 minutes until a meat thermometer in the thickest part shows {pull}.;Wrap it in foil and let it rest: the core keeps rising to {core}. Then let it cool completely and chill it for at least 1 hour.;Blend the drained tuna, the anchovies, the mayonnaise, 1 tbsp capers and the juice of half a lemon into a smooth sauce. Thin it with a little water if needed.;Cut the cold veal with a very sharp knife into slices as thin as possible.;Lay the slices on a plate, cover them with the sauce and top with the rest of the capers and a few lemon slices.

ingredients: 4 beef steaks (200 g each);800 g potatoes;40 g butter;2 sprigs rosemary;2 garlic cloves;salt and pepper
recipe: Take the steaks out of the fridge 30 minutes before and pat them dry. Heat the oven to 200 °C.;Cut the potatoes into pieces, mix them with oil, salt and rosemary and roast them for 30 to 35 minutes until golden.;Heat a grill pan or a heavy pan until it is smoking hot. Season the steaks with salt.;Grill the steaks for 2 to 4 minutes per side (depending on their thickness), turning them only once.;Check with a meat thermometer in the middle of the steak: take them off the heat at {pull}.;Put the butter and the crushed garlic on top and let the steaks rest for 5 minutes on a warm plate: the core rises to {core}.;Season with pepper and serve with the potatoes and the butter from the plate.

ingredients: 2 racks of lamb (8 ribs each);2 tbsp mustard;40 g breadcrumbs;1 bunch parsley;2 garlic cloves;600 g green beans
recipe: Take the lamb out of the fridge 30 minutes before. Heat the oven to 200 °C.;Trim the excess fat and season the racks with salt and pepper.;Brown them in a hot pan with a little oil, fat side first, for 2 to 3 minutes per side.;Mix the breadcrumbs with the chopped parsley, the chopped garlic and 1 tbsp olive oil.;Brush the lamb with mustard and press the breadcrumb mixture onto the fat side.;Roast for 15 to 20 minutes until a meat thermometer in the thickest part shows {pull}.;Let the lamb rest for 10 minutes under foil: the core rises to {core}.;Meanwhile cook the green beans in salted water for 6 to 7 minutes. Cut the lamb between the bones and serve.

ingredients: 1 kg stewing beef;150 g bacon;250 g mushrooms;12 small onions;3 carrots;750 ml red wine;2 tbsp flour
recipe: Cut the beef into 4 cm cubes, pat them dry and season with salt and pepper.;Fry the bacon in a large heavy pot until crisp and take it out.;Brown the beef in the bacon fat in small batches, 3 to 4 minutes per batch, until dark brown on all sides. Take it out.;Fry the sliced carrots and the peeled small onions for 5 minutes. Put the meat and bacon back in, sprinkle with the flour and stir for 1 minute.;Pour in the red wine and scrape the bottom of the pot. Add water until the meat is just covered.;Cover and cook in the oven at 160 °C (or on very low heat) for 2.5 hours until the meat falls apart.;Fry the mushrooms in a little butter until golden and stir them in for the last 15 minutes.;Season and serve with boiled potatoes, mashed potatoes or fresh bread.

ingredients: 600 g minced beef;4 burger buns;4 slices of cheddar;2 tomatoes;1 lettuce;1 red onion;ketchup and mustard
recipe: Divide the beef into 4 parts and shape loose patties, 1 cm wider than the buns. Press a small dent into the middle (it keeps them flat).;Chill the patties for 15 minutes. Slice the tomatoes and the onion and wash the lettuce.;Heat a grill or a heavy pan until very hot. Season the patties with salt and pepper just before cooking.;Cook them for 3 to 4 minutes per side. Only turn them once and do not press them.;Put a slice of cheddar on each patty for the last minute and cover the pan so it melts.;Check with a meat thermometer in the middle: the patty should reach {core}.;Toast the cut sides of the buns. Build the burgers: bun, sauces, lettuce, patty, tomato, onion, bun.

ingredients: 4 cod fillets;1 kg potatoes;200 g flour;250 ml cold sparkling water;oil for frying;1 lemon;salt
recipe: Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1.5 cm chips. Rinse them in cold water and dry them very well.;Heat the oil to 150 °C and fry the chips for 6 minutes until soft but still pale. Drain them.;Whisk the flour, a pinch of salt and the ice-cold sparkling water into a thick, smooth batter (it should coat a spoon).;Heat the oil to 180 °C. Pat the fish dry, season with salt and dust it with a little flour.;Dip the fish in the batter, let it drip and lower it slowly into the oil, away from you.;Fry for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and crispy. Drain on a rack.;Fry the chips a second time at 180 °C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and crispy.;Season with salt and serve with lemon wedges.

ingredients: 1 kg fresh clams;400 g spaghetti;3 garlic cloves;1 chili;100 ml dry white wine;4 tbsp olive oil;1 bunch parsley
recipe: Put the clams in cold salted water for 30 minutes so they release sand. Throw away any that are broken or stay open when you tap them.;Cook the spaghetti in plenty of salted water, but take them out 2 minutes before they are done. Keep a cup of pasta water.;Meanwhile fry the sliced garlic and the chopped chili in the olive oil in a large pan for 1 minute.;Add the clams and the wine, cover and cook over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes until they open. Throw away any that stay closed.;Add the spaghetti and a little pasta water to the pan and toss for 2 minutes until the sauce clings to the pasta.;Stir in the chopped parsley and a little olive oil and serve at once.

ingredients: 400 g spaghetti;800 g canned tomatoes;2 garlic cloves;1 onion;4 tbsp olive oil;1 bunch fresh basil
recipe: Chop the onion finely and slice the garlic.;Heat the olive oil in a pan and cook the onion over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic for 1 more minute.;Add the tomatoes, crush them with a spoon, and add 1/2 tsp salt.;Simmer the sauce without lid for 15 to 20 minutes until it is thick. Add a pinch of sugar if it is too sour.;Cook the spaghetti in plenty of salted water until al dente. Keep a cup of pasta water.;Toss the pasta with the sauce and a little pasta water for 1 minute.;Tear in the basil and serve with a drizzle of olive oil.

ingredients: 320 g arborio rice;400 g mushrooms;1 onion;100 ml dry white wine;1 litre vegetable stock;60 g parmesan;30 g butter
recipe: Heat the stock and keep it hot on a low flame.;Clean and slice the mushrooms. Fry them in half of the butter until golden, season and keep them aside.;Chop the onion finely and cook it in a little butter for 3 minutes until soft.;Add the rice and stir for 1 to 2 minutes until the grains are shiny.;Pour in the wine and stir until it has evaporated.;Add the hot stock ladle by ladle, stirring often, and wait until it is almost absorbed before adding more. This takes about 18 minutes.;Stir in the mushrooms for the last 3 minutes. The rice should be creamy and still have a slight bite.;Take it off the heat, stir in the grated parmesan and the rest of the butter, cover and wait 2 minutes before serving.

ingredients: 2 balls of pizza dough;400 g canned tomatoes;2 balls of mozzarella;1 bunch fresh basil;3 tbsp olive oil;salt
recipe: Take the dough out of the fridge 1 hour before. Heat the oven with a baking tray inside to the highest temperature (250 °C or more) for 30 minutes.;Crush the tomatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil and a pinch of salt (do not cook them).;Tear the mozzarella and let it drain on kitchen paper.;Stretch the dough with your hands on a floured surface into a thin round, keeping the edge a little thicker.;Put it on baking paper, spread a thin layer of tomatoes on it and add the mozzarella.;Slide it on the hot tray and bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the edge is puffed and spotted brown.;Top with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil and serve at once.

ingredients: 1 whole chicken (1.5 kg);1 lemon;1 bunch thyme;1 head of garlic;800 g potatoes;3 tbsp olive oil
recipe: Take the chicken out of the fridge 30 minutes before. Heat the oven to 200 °C.;Pat the chicken dry. Put the halved lemon, half of the thyme and a few garlic cloves inside.;Rub it with olive oil, salt and pepper, also under the skin of the breast.;Cut the potatoes into pieces and put them in a roasting tin with the rest of the garlic, thyme and oil. Put the chicken on top.;Roast for about 75 minutes until the skin is golden and the juice of the thigh runs clear. A meat thermometer in the thickest part of the thigh should show 75 °C.;Let the chicken rest for 10 minutes before carving. Serve with the potatoes and the juices.

ingredients: 4 duck breasts;3 oranges;2 tbsp honey;30 g butter;100 ml chicken stock;400 g green beans
recipe: Take the duck out of the fridge 30 minutes before. Score the skin in a diamond pattern without cutting into the meat. Season with salt.;Put the duck skin side down in a cold pan and heat it slowly over medium heat.;Cook for 8 to 10 minutes until the fat has melted and the skin is crispy and golden. Pour off the fat from time to time.;Turn the breasts and cook the meat side for 2 to 4 minutes until a meat thermometer shows {pull}.;Let them rest for 5 to 8 minutes under foil: the core rises to {core}.;Pour off the fat. Add the juice of 2 oranges, the honey and the stock to the pan and let it boil until it is syrupy (about 5 minutes).;Take it off the heat and whisk in the cold butter. Add a little orange zest.;Cook the green beans in salted water for 6 to 7 minutes. Slice the duck and serve with the sauce and orange slices.

ingredients: 400 g firm tofu;400 ml coconut milk;3 tbsp vegan green curry paste;300 g mixed vegetables;300 g jasmine rice;1 lime;1 bunch Thai basil
recipe: Rinse the rice and cook it with 1.5 times its volume of water: 12 minutes covered, then 10 minutes resting.;Press the tofu in a towel for 10 minutes, cut it into cubes and fry it in a little oil until golden on all sides.;Spoon the thick part of the coconut milk into a wok and fry the curry paste in it for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant.;Add the rest of the coconut milk and bring it to a gentle boil.;Add the vegetables (hard ones first) and simmer for 5 to 8 minutes until just tender.;Add the tofu and simmer for 2 more minutes. Season with soy sauce if needed.;Finish with lime juice and Thai basil and serve with the rice.

ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas (800 g);1 can tomatoes (400 g);2 onions;3 garlic cloves;1 piece of ginger;2 tbsp curry powder;300 g basmati rice
recipe: Rinse the rice and cook it according to the packet.;Chop the onions finely, chop the garlic and grate about 3 cm of ginger.;Heat 2 tbsp oil and cook the onions for 8 minutes until soft and golden.;Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute. Add the curry powder and fry for 1 more minute until fragrant.;Add the tomatoes, the drained chickpeas and 200 ml water. Season with salt.;Simmer for 20 minutes until thick. Crush a few chickpeas with a spoon to make it creamy.;Taste, adjust the salt and serve with the rice.

ingredients: 4 pork chops;2 apples;1 onion;2 tbsp mustard;150 ml apple juice;1 bunch thyme;800 g potatoes
recipe: Cook the potatoes in salted water for about 20 minutes until tender.;Take the pork chops out of the fridge 20 minutes before, pat them dry and season with salt and pepper.;Fry them in a hot pan with a little oil for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden. A meat thermometer should show 63 °C. Keep them warm under foil.;Cut the apples into wedges and the onion into slices and fry them in the same pan for 5 minutes until golden.;Add the apple juice, the mustard and a few thyme leaves and let it boil for 3 minutes until slightly thick.;Put the chops and their juices back in for 1 minute.;Serve the chops with the apples, the sauce and the potatoes.

ingredients: 400 g macaroni;250 g cheddar;600 ml milk;40 g butter;40 g flour;50 g breadcrumbs
recipe: Heat the oven to 200 °C.;Cook the macaroni in salted water 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain.;Melt the butter in a pot, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.;Add the cold milk little by little while whisking. Simmer for 5 minutes, still whisking, until the sauce is thick and smooth.;Take it off the heat and melt in three quarters of the grated cheddar. Season with salt and pepper.;Mix the sauce with the pasta and put it into a baking dish.;Sprinkle with the rest of the cheddar and the breadcrumbs.;Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

ingredients: 400 g firm tofu;1 broccoli;1 red pepper;1 piece of ginger;3 tbsp soy sauce;300 g rice;2 tbsp oil
recipe: Cook the rice according to the packet.;Press the tofu in a towel for 10 minutes and cut it into 2 cm cubes.;Heat the oil in a wok and fry the tofu for 5 to 6 minutes until golden on all sides. Take it out.;Cut the broccoli into small florets and the pepper into strips. Grate about 2 cm of ginger.;Stir-fry the broccoli in the wok over high heat for 2 minutes. Add the pepper and the ginger and stir-fry for 2 more minutes. The vegetables should stay crunchy.;Add the tofu and the soy sauce and toss for 1 minute.;Serve immediately with the rice.

ingredients: 400 g gruyère;400 g vacherin fribourgeois;300 ml dry white wine;1 garlic clove;1 tbsp cornflour;1 shot of kirsch;600 g bread in cubes
recipe: Grate both cheeses and mix them. Cut the bread into cubes, each with a little crust.;Rub the inside of the fondue pot with the halved garlic clove.;Heat the wine in the pot over medium heat until it is hot but not boiling.;Add the cheese handful by handful and stir in a figure of eight with a wooden spoon until it has melted.;Mix the cornflour with the kirsch and stir it in. Let the fondue simmer gently for 1 to 2 minutes until it is creamy and smooth.;Season with pepper and nutmeg and put the pot on the burner at the table.;Keep the fondue just bubbling and stir with every piece of bread you dip.

ingredients: 4 veal escalopes;100 g flour;2 eggs;150 g breadcrumbs;butter or oil for frying;2 lemons;potato salad
recipe: Put each escalope between two sheets of cling film and beat it with a flat pan until it is about 4 mm thin.;Season with salt and pepper.;Put the flour, the beaten eggs and the breadcrumbs into three flat plates.;Turn each escalope in flour, then in egg, then in breadcrumbs. Do not press the crumbs on.;Heat about 1 cm of fat in a large pan to 170 °C.;Fry the schnitzels for 2 to 3 minutes per side, shaking the pan so the fat flows over them and the crust puffs up.;Drain on kitchen paper and serve at once with lemon wedges and potato salad.

ingredients: 300 g paella rice;300 g prawns;500 g mussels;200 g squid;1 pinch saffron;1 litre fish stock;1 red pepper;150 g peas
recipe: Heat the stock with the saffron. Clean the mussels and cut the squid into rings.;Heat 4 tbsp olive oil in a wide paella pan. Fry the pepper strips and the squid for 5 minutes.;Add the rice and stir for 1 minute until it is coated with oil.;Pour in the hot stock, season with salt, stir once to spread the rice evenly and then never stir again.;Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes until most of the liquid is absorbed.;Put the prawns, the mussels and the peas on top and press them in lightly.;Cover with foil and cook for 5 to 7 more minutes until the mussels open and the prawns are pink.;Turn up the heat for the last minute to get a crispy crust at the bottom (socarrat). Let it rest for 5 minutes.

ingredients: 400 g spaghetti;150 g guanciale or bacon;4 egg yolks;1 whole egg;80 g pecorino;black pepper
recipe: Cut the guanciale into small strips.;Mix the egg yolks, the whole egg, most of the grated pecorino and lots of black pepper in a bowl.;Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente. Keep a cup of pasta water.;Meanwhile fry the guanciale in a dry pan over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes until crispy. Turn off the heat.;Add the drained spaghetti to the pan and toss it in the fat.;Wait 1 minute (the pan must not be too hot, or the eggs scramble), then add the egg mixture and 2 to 3 tbsp pasta water.;Toss quickly until the sauce is creamy. Serve with the rest of the pecorino and more pepper.

ingredients: 12 lasagna sheets;500 g minced beef;800 g canned tomatoes;1 onion;600 ml béchamel sauce;100 g parmesan
recipe: Chop the onion finely and cook it in a little oil for 5 minutes.;Add the beef and fry it until brown and crumbly, breaking it up with a spoon.;Add the tomatoes, salt and pepper and simmer for 30 minutes until thick.;Heat the oven to 180 °C.;Spread a little meat sauce in a baking dish. Layer pasta sheets, meat sauce and béchamel, and repeat 3 to 4 times.;Finish with pasta, béchamel and the grated parmesan.;Bake for 40 minutes until golden and bubbling.;Let it rest for 10 minutes before cutting, so the layers hold together.

ingredients: 3 eggplants;800 g canned tomatoes;2 balls of mozzarella;80 g parmesan;1 bunch fresh basil;olive oil
recipe: Cut the eggplants into 1 cm slices, salt them and let them drain for 30 minutes. Pat them dry.;Fry or grill the slices in olive oil until golden on both sides. Drain them on kitchen paper.;Cook the tomatoes with a little olive oil and salt for 15 minutes into a thick sauce.;Heat the oven to 190 °C. Slice the mozzarella.;In a baking dish, layer sauce, eggplant, mozzarella, basil and parmesan. Repeat until everything is used, finishing with sauce and parmesan.;Bake for 35 minutes until bubbling and golden.;Let it rest for 15 minutes before serving.

ingredients: 250 g rice noodles;200 g firm tofu;2 eggs;100 g bean sprouts;3 spring onions;60 g peanuts;3 tbsp soy sauce;2 tbsp tamarind paste;1 lime
recipe: Soak the noodles in hot (not boiling) water for 8 minutes until soft but still firm. Drain.;Mix the soy sauce, the tamarind paste, 1 tbsp sugar and 2 tbsp water into a sauce.;Cut the tofu into cubes and fry it in a hot wok with oil until golden. Push it to the side.;Crack the eggs into the wok and scramble them until almost set.;Add the noodles and the sauce and toss for 2 to 3 minutes until the noodles have absorbed the sauce.;Add the bean sprouts and the sliced spring onions and toss for 30 more seconds.;Serve with chopped peanuts and lime wedges.

ingredients: 1.5 kg chicken pieces;150 g bacon;250 g mushrooms;12 small onions;750 ml red wine;2 tbsp flour;1 bunch thyme
recipe: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.;Fry the bacon in a heavy pot until crisp. Take it out.;Brown the chicken in the bacon fat, skin side first, for 8 to 10 minutes until golden. Take it out.;Fry the peeled small onions and the mushrooms for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with the flour and stir for 1 minute.;Put the chicken and the bacon back in, pour in the red wine and add the thyme.;Cover and simmer gently for 1.5 hours until the meat is very tender.;Take the lid off for the last 15 minutes so the sauce thickens. Season and serve with mashed potatoes or bread.

ingredients: 2 eggplants;2 zucchini;2 red peppers;4 tomatoes;1 onion;3 garlic cloves;1 bunch thyme;5 tbsp olive oil
recipe: Cut the eggplants, zucchini and peppers into 2 cm cubes. Chop the onion and the garlic and dice the tomatoes.;Fry the eggplant in 2 tbsp olive oil until golden and take it out. Do the same with the zucchini.;Cook the onion and the peppers in the rest of the oil for 8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.;Add the tomatoes and the thyme and cook for 5 minutes.;Put the eggplant and the zucchini back in, season with salt and pepper.;Simmer gently for 30 to 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until everything is soft.;Serve warm or at room temperature with bread or rice.

ingredients: 400 g sushi rice;300 g very fresh salmon and tuna;4 nori sheets;1 cucumber;1 avocado;4 tbsp rice vinegar;soy sauce and wasabi and pickled ginger
recipe: Rinse the rice until the water is clear, then cook it with the same volume of water: 12 minutes covered, then 10 minutes resting.;Mix the rice vinegar with 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt. Fold it into the warm rice and let it cool to room temperature.;Cut the fish into strips 1 cm thick, and the cucumber and avocado into thin sticks.;Put a nori sheet on a bamboo mat, shiny side down. Spread a thin layer of rice on it with wet hands, leaving 2 cm free at the top.;Lay a strip of fish, cucumber or avocado along the bottom and roll up tightly with the mat.;Cut each roll into 8 pieces with a sharp, wet knife.;Serve with soy sauce, wasabi and pickled ginger.

ingredients: 600 g veal in thin strips;250 g mushrooms;1 onion;100 ml dry white wine;200 ml cream;800 g boiled potatoes for rösti;40 g butter
recipe: Grate the boiled potatoes (cooked the day before, cold) coarsely and season with salt.;Fry them as one big cake in butter for 10 to 12 minutes per side over medium heat until crispy. Turn it with the help of a plate.;Season the veal with salt and pepper. Fry it in butter over very high heat in two batches for 1 to 2 minutes until just brown. Take it out.;Fry the chopped onion and the sliced mushrooms in the same pan for 5 minutes.;Add the wine and let it reduce by half. Add the cream and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until slightly thick.;Put the veal and its juices back in and heat it for 1 minute only, so the meat stays tender.;Season and serve with the rösti.

ingredients: 800 g raclette cheese;1 kg small potatoes;1 jar of cornichons;1 jar of pickled onions;paprika and pepper
recipe: Boil the potatoes in their skins in salted water for 20 minutes until tender. Keep them warm in a basket under a cloth.;Cut the cheese into slices of about 5 mm. Take it out of the fridge 30 minutes before.;Heat the raclette machine for 10 minutes.;Put the pickles, paprika and pepper on the table.;Each guest melts a slice of cheese in a small pan under the grill for 2 to 4 minutes until it bubbles.;Scrape the melted cheese over the potatoes and season with pepper and paprika. Eat with the pickles.

ingredients: 2 kg mussels;2 shallots;200 ml dry white wine;30 g butter;1 bunch parsley;1 kg potatoes for fries
recipe: Cut the potatoes into thin fries, rinse them and dry them very well.;Fry them at 160 °C for 5 to 6 minutes until soft, then at 180 °C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden. Season with salt.;Meanwhile scrub the mussels, pull off the beards and throw away any that are broken or stay open when you tap them.;Melt the butter in a large pot and cook the chopped shallots for 2 minutes.;Add the wine and the mussels, cover and cook over high heat for 4 to 5 minutes, shaking the pot, until all mussels are open. Throw away any that stay closed.;Add the chopped parsley and some pepper and shake again.;Serve the mussels in their broth with the fries.

ingredients: 400 g pasta;2 eggplants;800 g canned tomatoes;2 garlic cloves;80 g ricotta salata;1 bunch fresh basil;olive oil
recipe: Cut the eggplants into 2 cm cubes, salt them and leave them for 20 minutes. Pat them dry.;Fry them in olive oil in batches until golden on all sides. Drain them on kitchen paper.;Fry the sliced garlic in 2 tbsp olive oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.;Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente.;Stir most of the eggplant into the sauce and toss it with the pasta.;Serve with the rest of the eggplant on top, grated ricotta salata and torn basil.

ingredients: 4 veal shanks;2 tbsp flour;1 onion;2 carrots;2 celery sticks;200 ml dry white wine;400 ml stock;1 lemon;1 bunch parsley
recipe: Cut the edge of the shanks in a few places so they stay flat. Season and dust them with flour.;Brown them in oil and butter in a heavy pot for 4 minutes per side. Take them out.;Chop the onion, carrots and celery finely and cook them in the same pot for 8 minutes.;Put the shanks back, pour in the wine and let it reduce by half.;Add the hot stock until the meat is half covered. Cover and braise over low heat for 1.5 to 2 hours, turning once, until the meat almost falls off the bone.;Mix the lemon zest with the chopped parsley (and some garlic) into gremolata.;Serve the ossobuco with its sauce, sprinkled with gremolata, with risotto or polenta.

ingredients: 800 g chicken breast;200 g yogurt;2 tbsp tikka paste;1 can tomatoes (400 g);150 ml cream;1 onion;300 g basmati rice
recipe: Cut the chicken into 3 cm pieces. Mix it with the yogurt, the tikka paste and a pinch of salt. Leave it in the fridge for at least 30 minutes (better 2 hours).;Cook the rice according to the packet.;Grill or fry the chicken pieces in a very hot pan for 6 to 8 minutes until slightly charred and cooked through.;In another pan, cook the chopped onion in oil for 8 minutes until golden.;Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Blend the sauce until smooth.;Stir in the cream and the chicken and simmer for 10 minutes.;Season and serve with the rice.

ingredients: 200 g dark chocolate;4 eggs;40 g sugar;200 ml cream
recipe: Melt the chocolate over a pot of simmering water (or in the microwave in short bursts). Let it cool until lukewarm.;Separate the eggs.;Whip the cold cream until it forms soft peaks. Keep it in the fridge.;Beat the egg whites with a pinch of salt until foamy, then add the sugar and beat until stiff and shiny.;Stir the egg yolks into the chocolate one by one.;Fold in a third of the egg whites, then gently fold in the rest and the cream until no white streaks are left.;Fill into glasses or a bowl and chill for at least 3 hours.

ingredients: 1 sweet shortcrust pastry;4 lemons;4 eggs;150 g sugar;100 g butter
recipe: Heat the oven to 180 °C. Line a tart tin with the pastry and prick the base with a fork.;Cover it with baking paper and dried beans and bake for 15 minutes. Remove the beans and bake for 5 more minutes until golden.;Grate the zest of 2 lemons and squeeze all 4.;Whisk the eggs and the sugar in a pot, add the lemon juice and zest and the butter in pieces.;Heat over low heat while whisking all the time for 6 to 8 minutes until the cream is thick. Do not let it boil.;Pour the lemon cream into the pastry and smooth the top.;Let it cool and chill for at least 2 hours before cutting.

ingredients: 200 g biscuits;80 g butter;600 g cream cheese;150 g sugar;3 eggs;200 g fresh berries
recipe: Heat the oven to 160 °C. Line the bottom of a 24 cm springform tin with baking paper.;Crush the biscuits finely, mix them with the melted butter and press them firmly into the tin. Chill for 15 minutes.;Beat the cream cheese (at room temperature) with the sugar until smooth.;Add the eggs one by one and mix only until combined (too much air makes it crack).;Pour the cream onto the base and bake for 50 minutes. The middle should still wobble slightly.;Turn off the oven and let the cake cool in it with the door slightly open for 1 hour.;Chill for at least 4 hours (better overnight) and serve with fresh berries.

ingredients: 500 ml fruit sorbet;250 g fresh berries;1 bunch mint
recipe: Put the bowls or glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes.;Wash the berries carefully and dry them on kitchen paper.;Take the sorbet out of the freezer 5 minutes before, so it is easier to scoop.;Dip an ice-cream scoop in warm water and serve 2 scoops per person in the cold bowls.;Add the berries and finish with a mint leaf. Serve immediately.

ingredients: 200 g hard cheese;150 g blue cheese;150 g soft cheese;1 bunch grapes;60 g walnuts;1 pack of crackers
recipe: Take the cheese out of the fridge 1 hour before serving.;Arrange the cheeses on a board from mild to strong: soft cheese, hard cheese, blue cheese.;Cut a first slice of each cheese, so your guests know how to cut it.;Wash the grapes, dry them and cut them into small bunches. Toast the walnuts briefly in a dry pan.;Add the grapes and walnuts to the board and serve with the crackers, a separate knife for each cheese.

ingredients: 250 g mascarpone;3 eggs;80 g sugar;200 g ladyfingers;300 ml strong espresso;2 tbsp cocoa powder
recipe: Make the espresso and let it cool completely.;Separate the eggs. Beat the yolks with the sugar for 3 to 4 minutes until pale and creamy.;Add the mascarpone and beat briefly until smooth.;Beat the egg whites until stiff and fold them into the mascarpone cream.;Dip each ladyfinger very briefly in the espresso (1 second per side) and lay them in a dish.;Spread half of the cream on top. Repeat with a second layer of ladyfingers and the rest of the cream.;Chill for at least 4 hours (better overnight). Dust with cocoa just before serving.

ingredients: 500 ml cream;5 egg yolks;80 g sugar;1 vanilla pod;4 tbsp brown sugar
recipe: Heat the oven to 150 °C. Put 4 small oven-proof dishes in a deep baking tin.;Cut the vanilla pod open, scrape out the seeds and heat them with the pod and the cream until steaming (do not boil).;Whisk the egg yolks with the sugar until combined, without making foam.;Slowly pour the hot cream onto the yolks while whisking. Pour through a sieve and skim off any foam.;Fill the dishes. Pour hot water into the tin until it comes halfway up the dishes.;Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until set but still trembling in the middle. Let them cool and chill for at least 3 hours.;Just before serving, sprinkle 1 tbsp brown sugar evenly over each cream and caramelise it with a burner until golden and hard.

ingredients: 1 pack of strudel or filo pastry;1 kg apples;80 g sugar;50 g raisins;50 g walnuts;1 tsp cinnamon;60 g butter
recipe: Heat the oven to 190 °C. Line a baking tray with baking paper.;Peel the apples, cut them into thin slices and mix them with the sugar, raisins, chopped walnuts and cinnamon.;Melt the butter.;Lay the pastry sheets on a clean kitchen towel, brushing each layer with butter.;Spread the apples on the lower third, leaving 3 cm free at the sides. Fold in the sides.;Roll the strudel up with the help of the towel and put it on the tray with the seam underneath. Brush with butter.;Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until golden and crispy. Let it cool for 10 minutes, dust with icing sugar and serve warm.

ingredients: 500 ml cream;60 g sugar;1 vanilla pod;2 g agar-agar;250 g berries for the sauce
recipe: Cut the vanilla pod open and scrape out the seeds.;Heat the cream with the sugar, the vanilla seeds and the pod while stirring.;Sprinkle in the agar-agar and boil for 2 minutes while whisking (agar-agar only sets after boiling).;Remove the pod and pour the cream into 4 glasses.;Let it cool and chill for at least 3 hours until set.;For the sauce, cook the berries with 1 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes and blend or mash them. Let it cool.;Pour the berry sauce over the panna cotta just before serving.

ingredients: 1 puff pastry;6 apples;120 g sugar;60 g butter
recipe: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Peel the apples, cut them into quarters and remove the cores.;Melt the sugar in an oven-proof pan (about 24 cm) over medium heat without stirring until it is golden caramel.;Take it off the heat and stir in the butter.;Place the apple quarters tightly in the caramel, rounded side down.;Cook over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes until the apples are soft at the edges and the caramel is bubbling.;Cover with the puff pastry, tuck the edges in around the apples and prick it a few times.;Bake for 25 minutes until the pastry is puffed and golden.;Let it rest for 5 minutes, then put a plate on top and turn the tart over carefully (hot caramel!). Serve warm.
